$comment: Thresholds of pipeline:line-names for cba (R3.4 step 1), read through lib/ign-match.ts classify(). COPIED from regions/nqn/ign.config.json on 2026-10-11 and PROVISIONAL for cba: they have not been calibrated on cba data. Only bufferM, high, medium and low are used by pipeline:line-names (the coverage buffer itself comes from lines.config.json: bufferM below largeMinStrahler, bufferLargeM from it up); the other keys (line, river*, minDetailPieceM, water) are kept so the file has the nqn shape for the later consumers (named, ign-streams, export). coverage = fraction of a reach within the buffer of the lines carrying one name; margin = coverage of the best name minus the runner-up.
